summary: Iter12 (LiveChat-style scroll-back) verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/chat/threads/{sid}: 6/6 pytest pass (auth guard, 404, chronological ordering with anchor last, soft-deleted filter, email-linked, public close regression). Frontend AgentDashboard: prior-thread-<sid> block renders with Started divider + Archived footer above the current thread, current-thread-divider present when priors exist and absent otherwise, prior msgs dimmed (opacity 0.9), composer targets the current session only, returning-customer-badge shows correct count.
critical_code_review_comments: AgentDashboard.jsx is now ~964 lines (grew 100 lines this iter with the scroll-back block) — exceeds the 700-line split guideline. Recommend extracting `PriorThreadsScrollback` and `MessagesList` sub-components for maintainability.

In the threads endpoint, the anchor-last ordering relies purely on `created_at` sort — if two sessions share timestamps the anchor could theoretically end up not last. In practice sessions have distinct created_at so it's fine; consider `.sort([('created_at', 1), ('id', 1)])` as a stable tiebreak. Low priority.

No AI 'Previous thread summary' amber card appeared for the prior thread in this run because the session was closed immediately with zero messages so ai_summarize returned falsy/short — expected per problem-statement note. Code path is guarded by `th.session.summary && …` so the omission is correct.
The scroll-back keeps rendering prior threads even in Archived tab if selected there — read-only path is fine but ai_suggest / composer are hidden so no user-facing issue.
seed_data_creation: Test creates anon sessions with unique client_id prefixes 'iter12_' / 'testcid_' / 'lonely_' — auto-purged before each pytest run and are namespaced away from other iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses key `token` (not `access_token`). Threads endpoint: /api/chat/threads/{sid} needs Bearer token. Anon session placeholder_email is deterministic from client_id (both sessions get SAME email — so email-linkage and client_id-linkage both find them). AgentDashboard uses api.get('/chat/threads/{sid}') on selection to populate priorThreads state; the current-thread-divider is only rendered when priorThreads.length > 0.
